decision.scope: Continuation of catherine-6g2 under hold: deliverable 2 (per-harness proved at declared bounds) stays open and the lane standard stays 8 GB / 300 s. This entry corrects the recorded wall location — propositional-reduction memory, not solver-phase time — and re-records the revisit triggers on that corrected basis.
decision.rationale: Four instrumented runs of build_panic_freedom (systemd memcg caps, logs target/kani-ab/, Kani 0.68.0 / CBMC 6.11.0, --default-unwind 16) reproduce an identical shape: symex clean at 88.7-94.7 s (zero unwind warnings — the 0003-era toxins stay gone), 72353 VCCs generated / 24066 remaining after simplification (the 24 k figure, now reproduced exactly), Convert SSA ~5.5 s, then the propositional reduction is OOM-killed by the kernel (constraint MEMCG, ~100% CPU, grinding not thrashing) at 8 GB with the default solver, at 8 GB with kissat, at 8 GB with kissat plus --slice-formula, and at 24 GB with kissat. No solver ever ran in any capped run: the wall precedes the SAT phase entirely. The 0003 attribution 'solve-phase volume / solve exceeds the 300 s wall' was an inference from a killed run whose log ends at Runtime Convert SSA — the same signature as today's reduction deaths — and is corrected here. Consequences: (1) solver tuning is dead as a lever at this formula size — kissat, the default solver, and formula slicing all die in reduction before handing the solver anything; (2) the budget stays closed: a bigger cap demonstrably buys only a bigger reduction (24 GB still OOM), consistent with 0003's reasoning; (3) the only live lever is the recorded arena shape — cfg(kani)-shaped fixed-capacity tables and indices on the proven path — justified now by reduction-memory, not solve-time: concrete-index arrays with asserted caps encode to a CNF that fits the standard, on the probe-matrix precedent (Vec-of-Vec over symbolic scalars at concrete bounds proves in seconds; lane construction verifies ~26 s). Revisit triggers, replacing 0003's: (1) arena structures as above, gated on build_panic_freedom reaching the solver at the 8 GB standard — reaching the solve is the phase gate even before a verdict; (2) a budget revision only via the Decision 6 stop gate, and only with a profile showing reduction inside the cap and solve time dominating; (3) a Kani release whose alloc modeling or reduction memory shrinks for symbolically-lengthed heaps — re-run build_panic_freedom under the standard first. Nothing is cited as proved; undetermined stays loud; the parsed kernel remains byte-identical and fully green.
decision.fixture_only_comparison: Unchanged from 0003 at the assurance level: the fixture corpus, contract suite, and parity nets pin the parsed surface byte-identically, and the undetermined lane still adds zero assurance over fixtures. What the four runs bought is diagnostic, not proof: the wall is located (propositional-reduction memory, >24 GB for the current formula) and the lever ranking is corrected (arena structures first, solver tuning retired). Cost: four bounded harness runs; the workspace suite, clippy, fmt, ah check, and the lane's recorded dispositions are untouched and green.
